children: FortuneX entered into a Business Combination Agreement to domesticate in Delaware and merge with WT Realty in an all-stock transaction valuing WT Realty at $600 million. The deal will issue 60,000,000 PubCo shares at a $10 reference price and establish a seven-member board post-closing. To support execution, the parties arranged sponsor and shareholder support agreements, planned lock-ups at closing, and an amended registration rights framework. WT Realty will also provide $2.43 million in non-interest Sponsor Loans to cover SPAC-related costs until closing.
